text.tspan: ESWCap C+R Meter — carrier board Rev C.1
Sheet 6 — Power, relay drivers, console, J8 bias header, MCU pin map
Team Praise Claude · Embedded Systems Workshop · 2026-11-14 · Sheet 6/7
USB-C VBUS → B5819WS → VDD5V → ME6231A33M3G LDO → +3V3 (all on the WeAct module)
J4-3/4 = +3V3 to carrier, J4-1/2 = GND; J2-2 = +3V3; J1-1, J2-1 = GND; J3-1/2 = GND, J3-3/4 (VDD5V) not connected.
Decoupling: C8 100 nF + C9 10 µF (bulk), C10 100 nF + C15 10 µF (relay coils), C11–C14 100 nF (one per IC: U1–U4).
K1_C also drives U9 LED through R41 (sheet 4). Firmware never energises K2 without K1.
1 BIAS_SET_F ← R34 1 kΩ ← BIAS_SET = PA4 (J2-10) TIM3_CH2 PWM; C16 10 µF to GND
2 BIAS_EN = PA15 (J1-10) GPIO; R35 10 kΩ pull-down
3 BIAS_MON_F → R36 1 kΩ → BIAS_MON = PA8 (J1-15) ADC5_IN1; C17 100 nF to GND
4 GND 5 +3V3 (< 50 mA) 6 BIAS_UART_TX = PC10 (J1-9) 7 BIAS_UART_RX = PC11 (J1-8) 8 GND
Complete MCU pin map (WeAct header pin → STM32 pin → net → peripheral)
Reserved by the module: PA11/PA12 USB, PA13/PA14 SWD, PF0/PF1 HSE 8 MHz, PC6 user LED, PC13 user key (active high), PB8 BOOT0, VREF+ = VDDA (R7 0 Ω).
blue text = net name (identical to the KiCad schematic)
green dashed box = inside the STM32; ◦ PAx (J2-n) = MCU pin (WeAct header pin)
small numbers next to a part = its pin numbers
